title: Register a team member
summary: Register them with their contact details; the email is their username to sign in.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: If the clinic reached its license's maximum number of users, a notice shows instead of the form.

steps.title: Email
steps.details: They sign in to the system with this email.

steps.title: Role
steps.details: Required: the role defines what they can see and do.

steps.title: Save
steps.details: Then send them the initial password from their record.
